title: Threads API Reference
snippet:
The Threads API consists of the following endpoints. Refer to each endpoint's reference document for usage requirements.
**Warning:** The Threads API can be accessed by either `graph.threads.com` or `graph.threads.net`.
| Endpoint | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Publishing](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/publishing) | Upload and publish Threads media objects, check their status, and repost and delete posts. |
| [Media Retrieval](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/media-retrieval) | Retrieve Threads media objects by ID or keyword. |
| [Reply Management](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/reply-management) | Retrieve replies and conversations and hide/unhide replies. |
| [User](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/user) | Retrieve a Threads user's profile, posts, replies, mentions, ghost posts, and publishing limit, and look up public profiles and their posts. |
| [Locations](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/locations) | Retrieve Threads location objects by individual ID. |
| [Location Search](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/location-search) | Search for locations to tag in Threads posts. |
| [Insights](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/insights) | Retrieve insights for Threads media objects and users. |
| [oEmbed](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/oembed) | Embed the content of Threads posts, such as photos and videos, in other websites. |
| [Debug](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/debug) | Inspect an access token. |

title: Retrieve user posts
snippet:
## Retrieve a list of an app-scoped user’s posts
Use the `GET /{threads-user-id}/threads` endpoint to return a paginated list of all posts created by a user.
Retrieving posts requires an appropriate access token and permissions based on the endpoint you are calling. While you are testing, you can generate tokens and grant your app permissions by using the Graph API Explorer.
- `threads_basic` — Required for making any calls to all Threads API endpoints.

title: Threads posts
snippet:
You can use the Threads API to publish image, video, text, or carousel posts.
This document covers:
- Single thread posts
- Carousel posts
- Label AI-generated content
- Topic tags, links, and GIFs
- Media specifications
Publishing posts requires the following permissions:
- `threads_basic` — Required for making any calls to all Threads API endpoints.
- `threads_content_publish` — Required for Threads publishing endpoints only.

Publishing a single image, video, or text post is a two-step process:
1. Create a media container with text only or with an image or video hosted on your public server with optional text using the `POST /{threads-user-id}/threads` endpoint.
2. Publish the media container using the `POST /{threads-user-id}/threads_publish` endpoint.

Use the `POST /{threads-user-id}/threads` endpoint to create a Threads media container.

title: Threads API overview
snippet:
You can use the Threads API to enable people to create and publish content on a person’s behalf on Threads, and to display those posts within your app solely to the person who created it.
The Threads API can be accessed by either `graph.threads.com` or `graph.threads.net`.
## Rate limiting
Calls to the Threads API are counted against the calling app’s call count. An app’s call count is unique for each app and app user pair and is the number of calls the app has made in a rolling 24-hour window. It is calculated as follows:
`Calls within 24 hours = 4800 * Number of Impressions`
The Number of Impressions is the number of times any content from the app user’s Threads account has entered a person’s screen within the last 24 hours.

### Posts
Threads profiles are limited to 250 API-published posts within a rolling 24-hour period. Carousels count as a single post. The `POST /{threads-user-id}/threads_publish` endpoint enforces this limit when attempting to publish a media container. Enforce the publishing rate limit in your app, especially if it allows app users to schedule posts for future publishing.
**Note:** This endpoint requires the `threads_basic` and `threads_content_publish` permissions.
#### Fields
| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `quota_usage` | Threads publishing count over the last 24 hours. |
| `config` | Threads publishing rate limit config object, which contains the `quota_total` and `quota_duration` fields. |
#### Example request
```
curl -s -X GET \
"https://graph.threads.com/v1.0/<THREADS_USER_ID>/threads_publishing_limit?fields=quota_usage,config&access_token=<ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```
#### Example response
```
{
"data": [
{
"quota_usage": 4,
"config": {
"quota_total": 250,
"quota_duration": 86400
}
}
]
}
```

title: User | Meta for Developers
snippet:
The Threads user endpoints allow you to retrieve a Threads user’s profile, posts, replies, mentions, ghost posts, and publishing limit, and to look up public profiles and their posts. See [Threads profiles](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/threads-profiles) for more information.
## Common parameters
These parameters work the same way on every endpoint on this page that uses them. Each endpoint lists the ones it uses.
| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `access_token` string | **Required.** Threads API user access token. |
| `since` datetime | **Optional.** The start date for retrieval, as a Unix timestamp (such as `1767225600`) or a date (such as `2026-01-01`). Must be on or after `1688540400` and before `until`. |
| `until` datetime | **Optional.** The end date for retrieval, as a Unix timestamp (such as `1767225600`) or a date (such as `2026-01-01`). Must be after `since` and no later than the current time. |
| `limit` int | **Optional.** The maximum number of media objects or records to return. The default is `25` and the maximum is `100`. Only non-negative numbers are allowed. |
| `before` string | **Optional.** A cursor for pagination. You cannot pass both `before` and `after` in the same request. |
| `after` string | **Optional.** A cursor for pagination. You cannot pass both `before` and `after` in the same request. |
---
## `GET /{threads-user-id}/threads`
### Parameters
This endpoint also uses these common parameters: `access_token`, `since`, `until`, `limit`, `before`, and `after`.
| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `threads-user-id` numeric string | **Required.** The path parameter of the Threads user identifier. |
| `fields` string | **Optional.** A comma-separated list of the fields to be returned. **Values:** `id` *(default)*, `media_product_type`, `media_type`, `media_url`, `permalink`, `owner`, `username`, `text`, `timestamp`, `shortcode`, `thumbnail_url`, `children`, `is_quote_post`, `alt_text`, `link_attachment_url`, `has_replies`, `reply_audience`, `quoted_post`, `reposted_post`, `gif_url`, `is_spoiler_media`, `text_entities`, `text_attachment`, `is_verified`, `profile_picture_url` |

title: Threads trending topics
snippet:
The Threads Trending Topics API provides businesses with data on current trending topics being surfaced on the Threads app, and lets you retrieve the top and recent posts for each trend.
## Before you begin
- All API requests must include the app’s [Threads access token](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/get-started/app-access-tokens).
## Limitations
- The Threads Trending Topics API is only for retrieving public trends and their related Threads posts. You may not transfer or modify trending Threads data, and you must restrict your app users from transferring or modifying trending Threads data.
- Only trending topics being surfaced on the Threads app for the following jurisdictions are available through the API:
- USA
- Japan
The Threads Trending Topics API requires an appropriate access token and feature approval.
- **Threads Trending Topics** feature — Required for making `GET` calls to the `/trending_topics` and `/<trend_id>/posts` endpoints.
If your app has not been approved for the **Threads Trending Topics** feature, you can only call the `/trending_topics` endpoint with **basic** access. Calling `/<trend_id>/posts` endpoint to retrieve posts related to a trending topic requires **advanced** access for the **Threads Trending Topics** feature.

## Retrieve trending topics by country code
**Endpoint:** `GET graph.threads.com/trending_topics?country_code=...`
### Parameters
| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `access_token` string | **Required.** Threads API [app access token](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/get-started/app-access-tokens). **Example:** `"TH\|<THREADS_APP_ID>\|<THREADS_APP_SECRET>"` |
| `country_code` string | **Required.** The country code of the country to fetch trending topics from. **Values:** `US`, `JP` |
### Returned fields
These are the **fields** for each object in the returned `trends` list.
| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `title` string | The display name of the trend. |
| `description` string | A description of the trend. **Note:** This field is not available in the Japan jurisdiction. |
| `trend_id` numeric string | The identifier of the trend object. |

**Endpoint:** `GET graph.threads.com/{trend-id}/posts?trending_post_type=...`
